name: size of ck3.exe
counting_rule: file size in bytes; changes with every game update and is the key under which fields and model are stored

name: RTTI type names in the list on disk
counting_rule: lines in the file check_rtti.ps1 produced, one per unique name, deduplicated case sensitively

name: RTTI type names according to memory.py
counting_rule: memory.type_name_count() on the same exe; equal to check_rtti.ps1 since that script started deduplicating case sensitively on 30 July 2026

name: widget vtables in the exe
counting_rule: vtables of classes descending from CPdxGuiWidget; 52 classes, two of which have two through multiple inheritance

name: gui files, game layer
counting_rule: files with the gui suffix under game\gui, all subfolders included

name: gui files, engine layer
counting_rule: the same under clausewitz\gui

name: gui files, jomini layer
counting_rule: the same under the whole jomini folder: 91 in jomini\gui plus the encyclopedia in jomini\jomini\gui, which a count on jomini\gui alone would miss

name: gui files in the game folder, total
counting_rule: every file with the gui suffix under the game folder: 416 game layer, 49 engine layer, 92 jomini layer and one developer file for the tweaker; this count is not tied to a folder and therefore cannot go quietly too low

name: English localization files
counting_rule: files with the yml suffix under localization\english, all subfolders included

name: lines in shortcuts.shortcuts
counting_rule: lines in the main file; the seven smaller files in the engine and editor layers do not count

name: map_data\positions.txt
counting_rule: file size in bytes

name: map_data\definition.csv
counting_rule: file size in bytes

name: map_data\adjacencies.csv
counting_rule: file size in bytes

name: 00_landed_titles.txt
counting_rule: file size in bytes

name: channel.dll
counting_rule: file size in bytes; changes with every rebuild of the DLL

name: derived field offsets
counting_rule: fields in fields.json besides the four bookkeeping keys; the seven layout offsets plus alpha and the window flag, which have been derived by toggling a window since 24 August 2026

name: characters per block
counting_rule: from model.json

name: model field culture
counting_rule: offset relative to the handle field, from model.json

name: model field rite
counting_rule: offset relative to the handle field, from model.json

name: model field dynasty house
counting_rule: offset relative to the handle field, from model.json; 312 on 1.19.0.6, and 1.20 put eight bytes in front of it

name: game state in the Bohemia save
counting_rule: unpacked size of gamestate in MB to one decimal; the file itself is 7751963 bytes

name: game state in the Ghur save
counting_rule: the same; the file itself is 7179229 bytes and its header is 23007 bytes, not 32720 as in the Bohemia save

name: expansions on disk
counting_rule: one metadata file with the dlc suffix per expansion folder; all 30 are enabled, because disabled_dlcs in dlc_load.json is empty

name: mod descriptors left in the mod folder
counting_rule: reference files in the mod folder. The five mods were switched off and unsubscribed on 1 October 2026 and their descriptors removed on 2 October; dlc_load.json names none

name: gui files in the Steam Workshop folder of the game
counting_rule: files with the gui suffix under the game's workshop folder, all subfolders included. Five mods brought 69 until they were unsubscribed on 1 October 2026; any gui file here is a mod that came back, and the decision against mods is in the maintainer's notes

name: texts the reading rule says over the harvest
counting_rule: every widget in a harvested record whose text is not empty once the game's markup is stripped, summed over the records that hold a window; refusal records carry a reason and no tree and do not count. Since 21 September 2026 the harvest holds the encyclopedia, 2344 texts in one window, and the windows harvested that day along a new shortcut or a chain

name: harvested texts that are in the tree but not on the screen
counting_rule: of those texts, the ones the reading rule skips: the rectangle falls outside the drawing area of that record, or it is clipped inside its scroll area, or an ancestor sits at alpha zero, or an ancestor carries 0x08 in its state byte - the game hiding it, which records carry since 20 September 2026. The union is smaller than the sum because a text can fail two at once. 172 of 1753 on 20 September 2026; on 21 September the rule gained the hidden state (563 texts) and the harvest the encyclopedia, most of whose list sits clipped

name: files that go into the repo
counting_rule: files under the project folder that .gitignore does not exclude; on 23 August 2026 git ls-files --others --exclude-standard counted the same number. 45 until 25 August 2026, when the click round added tools/ck3/openers.py and reports/openers.json; 48 when the gui reader added tools/ck3/guimap.py; 47 when docsearch.py was taken out, because it reads only the working notes; 50 since the NVDA sleep-mode add-on added three files under tools/nvda/addon; 52 since the alignment added tools/ck3/pairing.py and reports/pairing.json; 53 since the database reader added tools/ck3/database.py; 51 since the two text-field reports were dropped on 28 August 2026, being the only files under reports that no claim covered and that nothing read; 52 since 29 August 2026, when the record layout got its own deriver in tools/ck3/model.py; 53 since 29 August 2026, when the numbering moved out of the save into tools/ck3/numbering.py; 54 since 31 August 2026, when the beta gate added tools/never_silent.py; 55 since 1 September 2026, when the static map layer added tools/ck3/mapdata.py; 56 since 1 September 2026, when the chain from a character to a place added tools/ck3/place.py; 57 since 1 September 2026, when tools/unclaimed.py was added - the sweep for counts that close a door, which is the half check.py cannot see; 59 since 16 September 2026, when the first tests and the first lint configuration added pyproject.toml and tests/test_speech_seam.py - the speech round kept its one file under its new name check_speech_by_ear.py. That same day this measure read 80 for an hour, because pytest and ruff leave .pytest_cache and .ruff_cache in the project folder and nothing excluded them yet; 61 since 19 September 2026, when the presentation layer's first screen file added screens/event.screen and tools/ck3/screens.py; 62 the same day, when the drafts for every window added tools/ck3/propose.py; 63 that same day again, when the generic reading rule added tools/ck3/reading.py; 64 that same evening, when shutting the game down the way a player does added tools/ck3/quit_game.py; 65 since 20 September 2026, when the key loop added tools/ck3/reader.py; 66 that same day, when the character window got a screen file of its own in screens/character.screen; 67 since 1 October 2026, when tools/ck3/states.py came in

name: windows opened in the harvest round
counting_rule: records in harvest\ with opened true: 174 opened by the console, 17 by a shortcut, 8 by a click and 6 by a chain, counted 21 September 2026. The 15 that refuse carry a reason and no tree, and toolbars_window is the baseline state and is never harvested

name: text boxes in the harvest round
counting_rule: summed over the records: text boxes of a window that carry text, are not clipped, have no zero alpha above them and lie inside the drawing area, so they should be on screen

name: text boxes the recogniser confirmed
counting_rule: summed over the records: of those boxes, the ones an overlapping recognised line says the same thing about. harvest\ is outside the repo, so on a clone these measure nothing and drift - they belong to a round on one machine

name: text boxes outside the drawing area
counting_rule: summed over the records: boxes that would otherwise count, but fall wholly or partly outside the drawing area of that record. A window built by GUI.CreateWidget is not laid out where a player would see it, so counting these as misses measures the console route rather than the recogniser

name: windows in the map that a mod put there
counting_rule: entries in windows.json whose gui file exists in none of the three game layers (game, clausewitz, jomini); the map ships, so anything a mod added would be a window nobody else can open

name: gui files as the engine sees them, vanilla
counting_rule: the three layers merged on their shared virtual path, so a file the game layer replaces is counted once: 417 game, 71 jomini, 49 engine. Lower than the 558 counted on disk because 21 virtual paths exist in two layers

name: gui files as the engine sees them, with mods
counting_rule: the same with the enabled mods on top. None are enabled since 1 October 2026, so this equals the vanilla count; until that day five mods added 69 files and replaced no vanilla virtual path

name: global gui templates
counting_rule: distinct names declared as `type` or `template` in the merged set, later declarations winning; both keywords reach across files, which is why they share one table

name: file-local gui templates
counting_rule: names declared as `local_type`, keyed by file; all six sit in the developers' editor tools

name: windows with a name in the merged gui set
counting_rule: three shapes, one entry per name: a `window = { name = ... }` block at any depth; a block whose type resolves through its inheritance chain to `window` and which carries a name, at any depth; and a type definition that inherits from `window` and carries the name itself. **Do not add shapes here; use `windowmap.unmapped`**, which asks the running game instead: the engine builds every window up front, so the live tree is the whole list. windows.json holds the 265 of 1.19.0.6, checked that way on 20 September 2026; 1.20.0.2 added 18 and removed faith_creation_window, and the map has not been rebuilt for it yet

name: harvested widgets that carry text
counting_rule: every widget with a non-empty text in the 203 harvested trees, counted while walking, and the walk asserts it saw all 74548 widgets of every record; a live subtree whose parent found no source used to be skipped, which shrank this denominator by dropping exactly the hard cases

name: harvested texts paired with a place in a gui file
counting_rule: paired by class and child order only, never by name. 173 of them are a caption: a button carries its own text and the engine hangs a text box under it to draw it, so the box is not in the file and the widget above answers for it. The remaining 137 are texts the files describe nowhere, spread over 38 windows, and 76 of those sit in five developer windows - the debug map alone holds 42. They are listed per window in reports\pairing.json, so the share is recomputable rather than a number that ages

name: harvested texts whose gui file names a plain localization key
counting_rule: a text key that is in the localization and whose value holds neither a data function nor a quote of another key. DEFAULT_TEXT is counted apart because it is a placeholder for text the code sets

name: plain keys whose localization matches what was on screen
counting_rule: the check that can fail: game markup stripped from the screen text, style markup and icon tokens from the localization, then compared whole. All 578 agree, which is also what carries the caption model - had a button's caption not been the source of the box under it, those 173 would have disagreed

name: harvested texts filled by a data function
counting_rule: 334 where the gui file carries the call itself and 188 where it carries a key whose localization does; both need the data context of the ancestors to say who the sentence is about

name: harvested texts the gui file leaves to code
counting_rule: the widget carries DEFAULT_TEXT, so the files positively cannot say what will stand there and only a running game can; this is an answer, not a gap

name: HasDlcFeature checks in the merged gui set
counting_rule: every HasDlcFeature('x') in the merged files, counted by text. None of them sits on a window block: expanded over all 282 windows on 1 October 2026, on 1.20.0.2, not one window block carries such a check while 39 carry a visible of their own, so an expansion never takes a window away from a tester, only parts inside one

name: distinct expansion features the gui set gates on
counting_rule: distinct names inside those calls, by text over the files. Twelve of the fourteen are reachable from the expansion of a named window, measured 1 October 2026 on 1.20.0.2; all_under_heaven reaches 147 of the 150 windows that touch a feature, the others one to five each. Feature names match expansion titles - all_under_heaven is All Under Heaven, dlc022_ep4 - but most are named for the feature and not the expansion, so that mapping is not derivable from disk

name: cultures the engine loads
counting_rule: top-level keys in common/culture/cultures, game folder first and any enabled mods after it in load order, a file replacing the one at the same name. No mods are enabled since 1 October 2026; with the five of before, RICE brought most of 463

name: cultures that also have a name in the localization
counting_rule: of those keys, the ones the localization files also carry a sentence for. All of them, which is the check that the reader read the right part of the file rather than a plausible-looking wrong one

name: faiths the engine loads
counting_rule: since 1.20.0.2 a faith is a top-level key in common/religion/faith_types; mods written for 1.19 still hang theirs inside a religion under `faiths`, in common/religion/religion_types, and both places are counted, so a tester's mods are read too. No mods are enabled since 1 October 2026

name: cultures whose number the file order predicts
counting_rule: the vanilla save of 1066-09-15 carries the engine's own numbering, and for cultures it is exactly the file order. On 1.19.0.6, against a save made with the five mods of that time, this did not hold for the other databases: 78 of 237 faiths, 36 of 94 religions, 301 of 342 traits, so the numbering is read from the running game and not derived from disk. The save is named here rather than left to whichever is newest

name: harvested texts the gui files do not predict
counting_rule: of the 1754 harvested texts, the three kinds the files cannot foretell: the gui file says the code sets it, or the widget has a place on disk but no text source, or the alignment finds it no place at all

name: unexplained texts that inherit a data context
counting_rule: of those 631, the ones whose ancestors carry a datacontext, so that what the text is about is known even though where it comes from is not

name: unexplained texts in the developers' own windows
counting_rule: of those 631, the ones in a window whose gui file sits under gui/debug/ or whose name carries the word debug; fourteen windows, and nobody reads them

name: unexplained texts in windows a player opens
counting_rule: the 631 minus the developers' own windows, over 126 windows

name: unexplained bare numbers in windows a player opens
arguments: unexplained bare number in player windows
counting_rule: of those 470, the texts that are only digits and the punctuation a number carries, so that no word says what they are; two war scores in the ledger and two in the war overview

name: provinces that appear on the map image
counting_rule: distinct province numbers whose colour occurs in map_data\provinces.png; the definitions list more, and the difference is provinces no pixel carries

name: counties that hold land
counting_rule: counties in landed_titles with at least one barony that names a province, mods merged in load order

name: counties that have a neighbour
counting_rule: counties with at least one other county touching them, over the touching provinces plus the special links in adjacencies.csv; lower than the counties with land because an island county can have none

name: provinces that touch on the map image
counting_rule: unordered pairs of different province numbers that share an edge in provinces.png, water and impassables included; the special links of adjacencies.csv are not in this number

name: titles in landed_titles
counting_rule: blocks in landed_titles whose key starts with a tier letter, at every level of the nesting, mods merged in load order

name: titles that name a capital
counting_rule: titles carrying a capital line; every one of those capitals is itself a county, which is what makes the step from a title to a place one hop

name: titles that resolve to a county
counting_rule: titles for which county_for returns a county: a barony through its province, a county being one, anything above through its capital. The rest name no capital and hold no land, so they have no place at all

name: key bindings in shortcuts.shortcuts
counting_rule: every name = "keys" line in game\gui\shortcuts.shortcuts, generic entries included; a name starting with an underscore is the engine generic entry for one key combination and not an action of the game; those are counted apart from the named actions

name: named game actions with a shortcut
counting_rule: bindings whose name does not start with an underscore; a name starting with an underscore is the engine generic entry for one key combination and not an action of the game; those are counted apart from the named actions

name: shortcuts a posted key can reach
counting_rule: named actions whose keys carry no alt, ctrl or shift AND have a key at all. Four named actions are bound to an empty string and were counted here until 1 September 2026, when the round that presses them found 115 where the claim said 119. A modifier cannot be posted into the game - measured the same day, see brief\machine.md

name: shortcuts that need a modifier
counting_rule: named actions with a key that carries alt, ctrl or shift; counted from the same file in the same pass as the claim above, so the two plus the unbound four make up the named actions

name: shortcuts a widget declares
counting_rule: named bindings for which at least one widget in the merged gui set carries shortcut = "<name>"; the rest are handled in code and name nothing

name: shortcuts that resolve to a sentence on disk
counting_rule: of the declared ones, those whose text or tooltip key is in the merged localisation. The difference is texts that are a data function and therefore need the running game, such as [GetPlayer.Custom(...)]

name: named actions bound to no key at all
counting_rule: named actions whose key string is empty - event_option_14, menu_14, sub_tab_14, tab_14. They are declared and reachable by nothing, and counting them among the pressable keys is what made 119 out of 115

name: building boxes in the ledger
counting_rule: widget_building_item_ledger nodes in the expanded ledger_window; the boxes that show a holding’s buildings

name: widgets in a ledger building box that can act
counting_rule: widgets inside those boxes carrying onclick, onrightclick, shortcut or ondoubleclick - exactly one per box, the building_button itself, so nothing drawn over it can swallow a click

name: ledger building buttons that still reach the holding view
counting_rule: of those acting widgets, the ones whose surviving action names holding_view; the call on line 8338 is overwritten by the onclick on 8339, so this is zero and the last untried route to the holding view is shut
